technical.summary: Mixed momentum signals with overbought RSI and bullish trend structure, but price remains below key moving averages and below cloud, creating conflicting directional bias unsuitable for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: DOC shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 21 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (32/100) with bearish AAII sentiment (52.8%) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (360), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent CPI event, and real estate sector credit stress create severely adverse macro conditions; earnings in 21 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Supertrend bullish + PSAR bullish with RSI overbought-but-rising creates short-term momentum setup, and extreme market fear (32/100) with contrarian sentiment presents asymmetric risk/reward if macro stabilizes.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below both EMA-50 and SMA-200 with Ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental conviction, VIX crisis (360), imminent earnings event (21 days), and macro headwinds (rising dollar, credit stress, flat yield curve) make this a high-risk entry into structural weakness.
